key.name: hosts
key.description: List of SSH host aliases from ~/.ssh/config to query for Slurm jobs.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to poll hosts via SSH squeue (default: 60s = 1 minute).

key.name: connect-timeout
key.description: Timeout in seconds for each SSH connection attempt.

key.name: show-icon
key.description: Whether to show a symbolic icon next to the queue counts in the top bar.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Which panel box to place the indicator in ('left', 'center', or 'right').

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Index within the chosen panel box.
